reference_summary: Bitcoin recovered from below $81,000 to nearly $82,000 as gold and Asian stocks rebounded and the yen gave up early gains. Oil stayed near $100 a barrel, while preliminary figures showed investors withdrew $381 million from U.S. bitcoin funds on Thursday.
summary: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.
title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100

reference_summary: Ethereum developers postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade test on Hoodi after ChainSecurity found that proposed fee-accounting changes could make existing blockchain programs record failures permanently or reject valid operations. No new test date or main-network launch date has been confirmed, and the findings do not show that these proposed changes are currently being exploited.
summary: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.
title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts

reference_summary: Toto Finance is asking Cardano’s community treasury for 22 million ADA, about $5 million, to buy copper represented by blockchain tokens, with voting closing November 15. If the full budget is spent and ADA’s dollar price stays unchanged, copper would need to rise about 49.4% for the treasury to recover its investment.
summary: Toto Finance wants 22 million ADA from Cardano’s treasury to buy tokenized copper, and the metal would have to trade well above its all-time high for holders to get their money back.
title: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record

reference_summary: Franklin Templeton added about $150 million in blockchain-based shares of a fund investing in short-term dollar debt to the XRP Ledger, bringing the value recorded there to about $200 million. All shares remain in one wallet that shares authorized transaction signers with Franklin’s issuing account, and it is unclear whether it represents one investor or several.
summary: Franklin Templeton added about $150 million in shares of its tokenized money market fund to the XRP Ledger, bringing the network’s total to nearly 193 million shares worth about $200 million.
title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet

reference_summary: Robinhood executive JB Mackenzie said bets on bitcoin, gold and oil prices are among its fastest-growing prediction markets, where traders wager on whether an event will happen. Sports remains its largest category, but the Federal Reserve’s rate decision was September’s biggest event contract, and some crypto bets now settle in just 15 minutes.
summary: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil price contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction market products.
title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports

reference_summary: Bitcoin Core developers changed their security policy to release fixes and disclose flaws quickly when AI could easily rediscover them, replacing delays that could last months. Maintainers said the change should get fixes to users sooner, although the updates may undergo less testing; no bug had yet been handled under the new rule.
summary: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for bugs a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.
title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy

reference_summary: CoinDesk’s comparison of price swings over 90 days found bitcoin about as volatile as Nvidia and roughly eight times as volatile as the euro-dollar exchange rate. Bitcoin’s price swings have eased compared with its average since 2020, but remain more than three times those of the S&P 500 stock index.
summary: Bitcoin's price is as jumpy as Nvidia's and eight times more turbulent than the euro.
title: Bitcoin's price is as jumpy as Nvidia's and eight times more turbulent than the euro

reference_summary: Bitcoin traded near $81,500 after a volatile week, while Brent oil reached its highest level since early May ahead of the Federal Reserve’s October 27–28 meeting. U.S. bitcoin exchange-traded funds, stock-market funds that hold bitcoin, lost $635 million on Thursday, their largest daily withdrawal since June 25, according to Farside Investors.
summary: Yesterday’s 19 basis point slide in the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield was the largest one-day move downward since March 2023, when the failure of Silicon Valley Bank had investors worried about a domino effect across the country.
title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 as oil prices hit six-month high

reference_summary: Bitcoin’s recovery raises the possibility that its market low came months before the U.S. midterm elections, unlike previous downturns whose lows followed those elections.
summary: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history.
title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history

reference_summary: Sweden’s Riksbank revived debate on an e-krona, a central-bank-issued digital version of the national currency, calling it important for secure payments and monetary control. Lawmakers have not approved it, and a launch would take at least five years.
summary: Sweden’s central bank revives e-krona debate as stablecoins and digital euro loom.
title: Sweden’s central bank revives e-krona debate as stablecoins and digital euro loom
